tailoring.headline: Hybris Engineer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and integration pipelines across PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Experienced in agile international environments, CI/CD deployments, and production troubleshooting.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Hybris Engineer
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Hybris Engineer position at Ciklum. With over 5 years of hands-on professional experience building, extending, and supporting large enterprise e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: Headless & OCC APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs for storefront and third-party consumers, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Integrations & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub, resolving integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: Platform Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud CCv2, authored Groovy administrative scripts, managed the Hybris Admin Console, and led database query refactoring to reduce response latency.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my SAP Commerce expertise aligns with Ciklum's technical goals.

tailoring.why_company: I want to bring my 5+ years of specialized SAP Commerce Cloud engineering experience to Ciklum to help build and scale robust enterprise e-commerce platforms. Ciklum's reputation for delivering innovative digital solutions makes it an ideal environment to apply my backend, API integration, and platform optimization skills.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) engineering, Java/Spring backend depth, and robust API integration experience to Ciklum's engineering team.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw the Hybris Engineer opening at Ciklum. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java, and OCC API experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I believe my background is a strong fit. I am based in Germany with a valid work permit. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Hybris Engineer position at Ciklum. With over 5 years of enterprise experience in SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical capabilities in e-commerce platform delivery and integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. I am currently serving my notice period until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
